entities.summary: Eduardo Matarazzo Suplicy is a Brazilian politician, economist and professor. He is one of the founders and main political figures of the left-wing Workers Party of Brazil (PT). In the municipal elections of São Paulo in 2016 was consecrated as the most voted city councilor in the history of Brazil.
